# IronPDF
> IronPDF is the C# PDF Library to generate, edit, and sign PDFs in .NET 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, Standard, Core, and Framework.

## Agent Skill
- [IronPDF Agent Skill](https://ironpdf.com/skill.md): Drop-in SKILL.md that teaches coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot to use IronPDF correctly, covering installation, licensing, the core APIs and common pitfalls.

### Troubleshooting Guides
- [502 Bad Gateway](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/502-bad-gateway/): Troubleshoot 502 Bad Gateway errors in IronPDF. Find solutions to resolve connectivity and server response issues.

Follow this guide to troubleshoot permission issues.
- [Intermittent AccessViolationException During Form Processing](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/access-violation-form-processing/): Intermittent native AccessViolationException (c0000005) during PDF form processing is fixed by keeping the PdfDocument alive with GC.KeepAlive, removing manual GC.Collect calls, and targeting x64.
- [AccessViolationException After InsertPdf with HTML Headers/Footers](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/access-violation-insertpdf-html-headers-footers/): Fix AccessViolationException after InsertPdf in IronPDF Release builds. Apply headers and footers before merging, or use GC.KeepAlive on the source document.
- [Adding Bookmarks with ExtractTextFromPage](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/add-bookmarks-with-extracttextfrompage/): When Pages.Lines returns garbled text and breaks bookmark searches, use ExtractTextFromPage() to read each page in logical order and bookmark sections reliably.
- [Add Fonts Using CSS](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/adding-fonts-with-css/): IronPDF automatically embeds any font referenced through CSS; point RenderingOptions.CustomCssUrl at a stylesheet with an @font-face rule and the font is embedded with no font API calls.
- [Adding IronPDF to a software program installer](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/adding-ironpdf-to-a-software-program-installer/): Learn how to add IronPDF to a software program installer. Follow this guide to integrate IronPDF into your deployment process.
- [Adobe Fonts Embed as Type 3 Instead of TrueType](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/adobe-fonts-type3-truetype/): Adobe Fonts render as Type 3 instead of TrueType in IronPDF output; repackage the .ttf with FontForge to force TrueType embedding.
- [Docker Build Fails Due to xorg-x11-utils on Amazon Linux 2023](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/amazon-linux-2023-xorg-conflict/): Fix the xorg-x11-utils package conflict that prevents IronPDF Docker builds from completing on the Amazon Linux 2023 AWS Lambda .NET 8 base image.

- [ASP.NET Web Forms License Validation Issues](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/aspnet-webforms-license-validation/): IronPDF license validation fails in ASP.NET Web Forms when httpRuntime lacks targetFramework, causing TLS 1.0 usage. Set targetFramework="4.7.2" in Web.config.
- [Assembly Mismatch After Version Upgrade in .NET Framework](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/assembly-mismatch-in-version-upgrade-for-net-framework-projects/): Fix IronPDF assembly mismatch errors in .NET Framework by deleting stale bin and runtimes folders, then reinstalling packages via NuGet.
- [Author Names in PDF Metadata](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/author-entity-pdf-metadata/): Most PDF editors split a comma-separated Author field into multiple authors; use a vertical bar or hyphen instead to keep the author as a single entity in IronPDF metadata.

- [Memory Leak in IronPDF](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/memory-leak-in-ironpdf/): Troubleshoot memory leak issues in IronPDF. Follow this guide to identify and resolve memory management problems.
- [MetaData Visibility](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/metadata-visibility/): Learn how to manage metadata visibility in PDFs using IronPDF. Follow this guide to handle document metadata effectively.
- [Missing Dependencies in IronPDF Lambda Deployment](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/missing-dependencies-lambda-deployment/): Fix missing native dependency errors when deploying IronPDF to AWS Lambda by switching to IronPdf.Slim and verifying Dockerfile configuration.
- [Mixing Major Versions of IronPDF, IronOCR, and IronBarcode](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/mixing-major-versions-iron-suite/): Combining different major versions of Iron Software products in one project causes assembly binding conflicts; align every library to the same monthly version.
- [Monitor .NET Process Memory in Linux/WSL](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/monitor-memory-usage-linux-wsl/): Track a .NET process's memory consumption from the console in Linux or WSL using PrivateMemorySize64 or external tools like top, ps, and smem.
- [Network service crashed, restarting service](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/network-service-crashed-restarting-service/): Troubleshoot network service crashes and restarting issues in IronPDF. Follow this guide to ensure reliable service operation.
- [No function was found with the name SetLogEvent with error code (125)](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/no-function-was-found-setlogevent-127/): Troubleshoot SetLogEvent 125 errors in IronPDF. Follow this guide to resolve function-related issues and ensure smooth operation.
- [IronPDF Fails with Non-ASCII Characters in File Paths](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/non-ascii-file-path/): IronPDF fails with non-ASCII file paths, logging 'Invalid (empty) temp path'. Set Installation.TempFolderPath to an ASCII-only path to fix the error.
- [Orphaned CEF Subprocess on macOS ARM After a Crash](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/orphaned-cef-processes-macos-arm/): IronPDF 2026.4.1 on macOS ARM leaves its CEF subprocess running after a crash, which is fixed by updating the IronPdf packages to 2026.5.2 or later.
- [Out-of-Order Text Extraction from Tightly Packed Tables](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/out-of-order-text-extraction/): page.Lines scrambles text in tightly packed tables by merging rows with overlapping Y positions. Use page.TextChunks with BoundingBox grouping to fix it.
- [Override CSS @page Rules with RenderingOptions](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/override-css-page-rules-renderingoptions/): CSS @page rules in HTML override IronPDF RenderingOptions settings for PaperSize and MarginTop in the Chrome renderer. Remove the @page rule to fix this.
- [IronPDF Package Size](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/package-size-ironpdf/): Learn how to manage and optimize package sizes for IronPDF. Follow this guide to reduce package bloat and improve deployment efficiency.
- [PDF Page Resize, Extend, and Transform](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/page-resize-extend-transform/): Picking the wrong page method clips or shifts content; learn when to use Resize, Extend, and Transform to change page size, add margins, or move content.
- [PDF Version](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/pdf-version/): Learn how to handle different PDF versions in IronPDF. Follow this guide to ensure compatibility and proper document handling.
- [IronPDF PDF/UA Compliance](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/pdfua-compliance/): IronPDF generates tagged PDFs that conform to ISO 14289-1 (PDF/UA-1) and pass VeraPDF validation, though stricter tools like PAC may still report accessibility issues.
- [PDF/UA Rendering Turns Images and Boxes Gray](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/pdfua-rendering-gray/): Images, SVGs, and boxes appear gray in IronPDF when using ConvertToPdfUA() or SaveAsPdfUA() due to a Chromium compositing bug in PDF/UA mode.
- [Pixel Perfect HTML Formatting](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/pixel-perfect-html-formatting/): Learn how to achieve pixel-perfect HTML formatting in PDFs using IronPDF. Follow this guide to ensure accurate rendering of HTML content.

- [Rasterize to Image using MemoryStream in .NET 10](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/rasterize-to-image-using-memorystream/): Learn how to rasterize PDFs to images using MemoryStream in IronPDF. Follow this guide to convert and handle PDF images efficiently.
- [System.Environment.FailFast with ReadyToRun](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/readytorun-failfast/): A .NET app published with ReadyToRun crashes at the first IronPDF call; fix it by excluding IronPdf.dll from ReadyToRun compilation.
- [Rectangle Construction and Positioning in IronPDF](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/rectangle-construction-positioning/): Rectangles drawn in IronPDF behave differently from IronOCR and IronBarcode; learn how the PDF coordinate system, x/y values, width, height, and units control placement.
- [Red Hat Enterprise Linux support](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/red-hat-enterprise-linux-support/): Learn how to deploy and troubleshoot IronPDF on Red Hat Enterprise Linux. Follow this guide to ensure smooth integration and performance.
- [Image Header or Footer Without Inflating PDF Size](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/reduce-pdf-size-base64-headers-footers/): Base64 header or footer images balloon the output because they re-embed on every page, so split the layout into a static image pass and a dynamic text pass to embed the image once.
- [Reduce the IronPDF Runtimes Folder Size](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/reduce-runtimes-folder-size/): IronPDF's runtimes folder is large because it ships native binaries for every platform; publish with a single -r RID and --self-contained false to shrink the deployment.
- [Registry is not supported on this platform](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/registry-is-not-supported-on-this-platform/): Troubleshoot 'Registry is not supported on this platform' errors in IronPDF. Follow this guide to resolve platform-specific issues.
- [Render Delay & Timeout](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/render-delay-timeout/): Troubleshoot render delay timeout issues in IronPDF
- [Preventing HTML to PDF Rendering Crashes in .NET Framework](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/rendering-crashes-dotnet-framework/): IronPDF rendering crashes in .NET Framework because the Prefer 32-bit setting caps memory at 2 GB. Uncheck it in Visual Studio to run as 64-bit.
- [Properly Initializing RenderingOptions in IronPDF](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/rendering-options-initialization/): Fix IronSoftwareDeploymentException in IronPDF when GetRendererOptions() is called inside a ChromePdfRenderer object initializer in C#.
- [Segmentation Fault on AWS Lambda](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/segmentation-fault-aws-lambda/): Troubleshoot segmentation fault on AWS Lambda in IronPDF. Follow this guide to improve performance.
- [SixLabors Licensing and IronPDF](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/sixlabors-dependency-licensing/): SixLabors changed its licensing across versions, but IronPDF already covers the commercial license so no action is required.
- [Sophos Exploit Mitigation Blocks IronPDF Native DLL Load](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/sophos-dynamicshellcode-detection/): Sophos DynamicShellcode heuristics block IronPDF native DLL load in .NET Framework apps; fix it with a narrow certificate-based Sophos exclusion or by running IronPdfEngine in gRPC remote mode.
- [Transparency and Color in PDF-to-Image Conversion](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/transparency-color-rendering/): When IronPDF rasterizes a PDF that uses transparency or blended layers, colors can differ slightly from Adobe Acrobat; this matches Chrome's rendering and is expected, not an error.
- [IronPDF Ubuntu 24.04 Dependency Issue on .NET 9 and .NET 10](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/ubuntu-2404-dotnet9-dependency/): Fix IronPDF startup failures on Ubuntu 24.04 with .NET 9 and .NET 10 caused by the libasound2 to libasound2t64 library rename in Ubuntu 24.04.
- [Unable to Connect to Licensing Server | IronPdf](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/unable-to-connect-to-licensing-server/): Learn how to solve the issue of unable to connect to licensing server. Ensure your applications are running properly.
- [Unidentical PDF Rendered with Chrome Print Preview](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/unidentical-pdf-chrome-print-preview/): IronPDF output differs from Chrome Print Preview due to a CEF version gap; fix it with IronPdf.UpdatedChrome or WaitFor.RenderDelay.
- [Rendering Fixes in IronPdf.UpdatedChrome](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/updated-chrome-rendering/): When the standard IronPdf package misrenders modern CSS, switch to IronPdf.UpdatedChrome, which ships a newer Chromium engine that resolves those layout issues by design.
- [IronPdf.UpdatedChrome for Faster HTML Rendering](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/updatedchrome-rendering-performance/): Slow HTML-to-PDF rendering on modern, complex pages improves when you switch to the IronPdf.UpdatedChrome package, which ships a newer Chromium engine.
- [Vulkan and ANGLE Initialization Errors in Docker](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/vulkan-angle-initialization-docker/): IronPDF logs a Vulkan/ANGLE initialization error in Docker and Lambda. Set ChromeGpuMode to Disabled and SingleProcess to true to suppress it.
- [WCAG and PDF/UA](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/wcag-and-pdf-ua/): WCAG and PDF/UA are two accessibility standards that are often confused; this explains how they differ and where IronPDF fits in.
- [Missing Fonts on Windows Server Core](https://ironpdf.com/troubleshooting/windows-server-core-container-fonts/): IronPDF crashes with a STATUS_STACK_OVERFLOW exit code on Windows Server Core because it lacks system fonts, fixed by installing and registering a font such as Arial.
